// diagnostic

E0711

The `Authority` handle `{handle}` can't escape its `#FX` block.

What

The `Authority` handle `{handle}` can't escape its `#FX` block.

Why

`#FX(…)` revokes the `Authority` at scope end (RAII); returning, storing, or capturing the handle would let revoked rights outlive the scope.

Fix

use the handle only inside the `#FX` block, or perform the work that needs it there.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0711: tests/ui/authority_named_handle_escapes.stderr.

Error [E0711]: the `Authority` handle `authority` can't escape its `#FX` block
  --> tests/ui/authority_named_handle_escapes.jet:4:18
    |
  4 |         alias :: authority
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#FX(…)` revokes the `Authority` at the end of its block (RAII); returning, storing, or sharing `authority` would let revoked rights outlive the scope
 Fix: use `authority` only inside the `#FX` block, or perform the work there
